input: Find a local macramé workshop to try once

gold.taskTitle: Find and Attend a Local Macrame Workshop Once
gold.taskDescription: Research and sign up for a single local macrame workshop to try the craft for the first time.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the specific location to search for nearby workshops.

questions.title: Do you have a budget limit for the workshop fee?
questions.description: Understand the maximum amount the user is willing to spend.

questions.title: Are there specific dates or days of the week that work?
questions.description: Determine scheduling availability to filter workshops by timing.

questions.title: Is this your first time doing macrame at all?
questions.description: Clarify experience level to target beginner-friendly sessions.

questions.title: Do you prefer a small class or a larger group setting?
questions.description: Understand the preferred social environment for the workshop.

questions.title: Should the workshop focus on a specific macrame project type?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants to make something particular, like a wall hanging or plant hanger.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the venue?
questions.description: Establish a distance or travel time limit to filter results by proximity.
